sources.title_zh: 據報導，一些 Anthropic 的資深人士正在購買偏遠土地，以防「AI 出錯」
sources.title_en: Some Anthropic veterans are reportedly buying remote land in case "AI goes awry"
sources.title_original: Some Anthropic veterans are reportedly buying remote land in case "AI goes awry"
sources.summary: According to the Wall Street Journal, some of Anthropic's longest-serving employees are considering buying land in remote parts of the US as a refuge in case AI goes awry. The report traces the company's deep ties to the Effective Altruism movement and a Bay Area network of "doomers" who've been gaming out doomsday scenarios for over a decade. The article Some Anthropic veterans are reportedly buying remote land in case "AI goes awry" appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據《華爾街日報》報導，Anthropic's的一些資深員工正考慮在美國偏遠地區購買土地，作為AI失控時的避難所。該報導追溯了該公司與「有效 altruism（有效利他主義）」運動的深厚淵源，以及灣區一群十多年來一直在模擬世界末日情境的「末日論者」網路。「部分Anthropic老員工據傳正在購買偏遠土地以防『AI失控』」一文最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: AI agents do more of the work in model development, but humans still make the decisions
sources.summary: A research team analyzed 769 task logs from building its own AI model. AI agents supplied up to 55 percent of method proposals, but humans made more than 85 percent of final decisions. A third of the tasks wouldn't have been attempted without AI. The authors warn that more agent activity doesn't mean more autonomy. The article AI agents do more of the work in model development, but humans still make the decisions appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 研究團隊分析了建構自家 AI 模型時的 769 個任務日誌。AI 代理提供了高達 55% 的方法提案，但人類做出了超過 85% 的最終決策。若沒有 AI，有三分之一的任務將不會被嘗試。作者警告說，更多的代理活動並不意味著更高的自主性。「AI 代理在模型開發中完成了更多工作，但人類仍然做出決策」一文最先出現在 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Goldman Sachs projects that Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Oracle, and Meta will pour a combined $1.2 trillion into AI infrastructure in 2027, more than 50 percent above this year's levels. Measured against GDP, it would be the biggest investment cycle since railroad construction in the 19th century. Bottlenecks in power, labor, and memory chips could slow the pace, though. The article Goldman Sachs expects Big Tech to spend $1.2 trillion on AI infrastructure by 2027, dwarfing Wall Street estimates appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.summary: On Friday I gave the closing keynote at the WeAreDevelopers World Congress North America in San Jose. I tied together the key trends from the past year into a chronological exploration of everything that happened in 2026. The video is on YouTube ; here are my annotated slides and notes to accompany the talk. # I'm going to give a lightning tour of everything that has happened so far in 2026. The year isn't over yet! # For me, 2026 started a couple of months earlier in November 2025. # November saw the release of two important models: Claude Opus 4.5 and GPT-5.1. As is usually the case with new models, these were incremental improvements on the models that came before them. But every now and then when a model improves, it crosses an invisible line where something that didn't really work starts working. In this case, the thing that started working was their coding agents. Claude Code had been around since February 2025, Codex was a little younger. These two new models, when paired with their respective coding agent harnesses, improved from "often make mistakes" to "reliable enough to use on a day-to-day basis". # For a couple of years now I've been evaluating new models by asking them to "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle". It's probably the world's stupidest benchmark - there's only so much you can learn from it. But it's still a challenge for models, because drawing pelicans is difficult, drawing bicycles is difficult, and pelicans can't ride bicycles in the first place. Here's the state of the art for November. Claude still couldn't really draw a bicycle! The G
sources.summary_zh: 週五我在聖荷西舉辦的 WeAreDevelopers 世界大會北美場（WeAreDevelopers World Congress North America）發表了閉幕主題演講。我將過去一年的關鍵趨勢串聯起來，按時間順序探討了 2026 年發生的所有事情。影片已上傳至 YouTube；以下是配合演講的加註投影片和筆記。# 我將快速導覽 2026 年至今發生的所有事情。這一年還沒結束！# 對我而言，2026 年提早了幾個月從 2025 年 11 月開始。# 11 月發布了兩個重要的模型：Claude Opus 4.5 和 GPT-5.1。正如新模型的常態，這些都是對先前模型的漸進式改進。但每隔一段時間，當模型有所改進時，它就會跨越一條無形的分界線，讓原本不太起作用的功能開始運作。在這種情況下，開始運作的是它們的程式碼代理程式。Claude Code 從 2025 年 2 月起就已經存在，Codex 則稍微年輕一些。這兩個新模型在與各自的程式碼代理程式框架搭配使用時，從「經常犯錯」改進為「足以在日常生活中使用的可靠程度」。# 幾年來我一直在評估新模型，方法是要求它們「產生一張鵜鶘騎腳踏車的 SVG」。這可能是世界上最愚蠢的基準測試——從中能學到的東西非常有限。但對模型來說這仍然是個挑戰，因為畫鵜鶘很難、畫腳踏車很難，而且鵜鶘本來就不能騎腳踏車。以下是 11 月時的最新技術水準。Claude 依然無法真正畫出腳踏車！G
